SELECT c.client_id, a.account_id
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp AS p ON c.client_id = p.client_id
JOIN account AS a
  ON d.district_id = a.district_id
 AND p.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) BETWEEN '1983' AND '1987'
